sources.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free

cards.summary: The new terms , which go into effect on October 30th, say Meta can use this outside content to "develop, improve, research," and "train" its AI products. While Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts says that the company is just "consolidating" its commercial and self-serve ad terms, legal experts tell Nieman Lab that this could allow Meta "to argue its commercial terms supersede other blocking instructions," like a site's robots.txt file .
cards.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free

sources.title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social

cards.summary: Bluesky's Attie AI tool, which initially launched earlier this year as a way to use AI to build your own feeds, now lets you make "small" social apps like games, polls, and dashboards that you can then share with others as their own websites. In an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt , Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider said to think of Attie as "social vibe coding or vibe coding for your community." You can make your own Attie app by typing in a prompt.
cards.title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
